## Why This Is Asked
Tests real-world streaming ingestion with schema drift, Delta Lake upserts, governance, and reliability in Azure.

## Key Concepts
- Azure Event Hubs + Schema Registry
- Delta Lake MERGE for upserts and schema evolution
- Databricks Spark Streaming or Synapse Spark

```python
deltaTable = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, "/mnt/delta/telemetry")
(deltaTable.alias("t").merge(
  source_df.alias("s"), "t.device_id = s.device_id"
).whenMatchedUpdate(set={"t.metrics": "s.metrics", "t.ts": "s.ts"})
 .whenNotMatchedInsertAll()

```

```javascript
// Pseudocode: DLT table creation with schema drift
createDeltaTable("facts_payments", mergeOn="payment_id")
  .withSchemaEvolution(true)
  .withExpectations({
    quality: "payment_amount > 0",
    completeness: "payment_id IS NOT NULL"
  })
  .withWatermark("event_timestamp", "5 minutes")
  .withPurviewLineage(true);
```
